What Happens After You Contact Me?

Once you submit your enquiry, I'll review your project details, clarify any questions and discuss the most suitable next steps. Here's what you can generally expect when starting a website or digital development project.
Tell me about your business, project goals, required features and any existing website.
I'll review your requirements and clarify the scope, priorities and possible solutions.
We'll discuss the proposed approach, deliverables and timeline before moving forward.
Find answers to common questions about project enquiries, website development, timelines and working together before you get in touch.
Not sure what your project needs yet?

You don't need a complete project brief to get started. Whether you're planning a business website, an online store or a custom digital solution, I can help you clarify the requirements and identify a suitable next step.
1. Can I contact you before I have a full project brief?
Yes. A summary of your business, goals and current challenges is enough to begin a conversation.
2. Do you work with businesses outside your country?
Yes. I work with remote clients and can discuss requirements online across different markets.
3. Can you improve an existing website instead of building a new one?
Depending on the existing website and your goals, a redesign or targeted improvements may be more suitable than a full rebuild.
4. What should I include in my initial enquiry?
Tell me the type of website or solution you need, your key goals, useful reference links, and any timeline or budget considerations.
5. How much does a professional website or digital project cost?

Project costs depend on the number of pages, design requirements, features, integrations and technical complexity. After reviewing your project details, I can provide a quotation based on the agreed scope and deliverables.
6. How long does it take to develop a website?

Development timelines vary depending on the project size, functionality, content readiness and revision requirements. A straightforward business website generally takes less time than a complex e-commerce store or custom digital system. I'll discuss a realistic timeline after reviewing your requirements.
7. Which website platforms and technologies do you work with?

I work with WordPress, Elementor, Divi, WooCommerce, Shopify, Wix Studio and other suitable website platforms and tools. The recommended technology depends on your business goals, content management needs, required features and long-term plans.
Explore my services to understand the options available for your website or digital project.

Oderinde Stephen Web & Digital Solutions provides website development, e-commerce solutions, website redesigns and digital services for businesses in the United Kingdom, Europe, the United States, Canada, Australia and beyond. Based in London, the business collaborates remotely with clients to plan, develop and deliver digital projects tailored to their goals.
How can I contact Oderinde Stephen Web & Digital Solutions?
Email Contact@oderindestephen.com, phone +44 7848 149224, submit the website project enquiry form, or book a strategy call at cal.com/oderinde/free.
Do you support international and remote website projects?
Yes. Project discussions and collaboration can take place remotely. The agreed communication methods, milestones and delivery dates depend on the individual project.
